answer: Each challenge is instantiated from a specified future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature makes its value publicly verifiable and unpredictable before release. A participant commits to a response before the reveal deadline, then proves it against the pulse-derived task; this blocks advance solutions and offline replay, while per-challenge costs and rate limits constrain sybil swarms. A lotus-marked voyage may use a cedar-seeded task, but neither label substitutes for verification.
